definitions.explanation: A first-year or newly debuted player or member, especially in professional sports. From English 'rookie.'

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ルーキー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初出場|はつしゅつじょう}→初出場：26884_hatsushutsujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}した→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: That rookie performed well in his first appearance.

examples.japanese: ルーキー⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Despite being a rookie, he repeatedly made game-deciding plays this season.

notes:
Loanword from English 'rookie.' Most common in professional sports such as baseball and soccer, referring to a first-year player.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ルーキーイヤー: rookie year
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルーキー: a promising rookie
- ルーキー⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: a rookie player

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧: newcomer; new employee — broader, used in workplaces as well as sports
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧: beginner — focuses on lack of skill, not on being newly arrived
